title: Business Intelligence Software Pricing In 2026: 9 Tools Compared
summary: 2026 list prices for Power BI, Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Qlik, Metabase and 4 more BI tools, with the yearly cost for 10, 100 and 500 people and sources.
body_markdown:
Business intelligence software costs a 100-person team about $8,000 to $75,000 a year at 2026 list prices: $8,040 on Metabase Cloud Starter, $16,800 on Power BI Pro, $31,680 on Tableau Cloud Standard, $60,000 on Tableau Cloud Enterprise or ThoughtSpot Analytics Pro, and $74,880 on Supaboard Business. A 10-person team pays $1,560 to $12,000 a year. At 500 people, plans priced by headcount run from $36,840 to $374,400, while Qlik Cloud Analytics Standard stays at $9,900 because it charges for data, not users.


Looker, Domo, Sigma and Omni do not publish their plan prices. Power BI's F64 capacity, which lets viewers read reports without a seat, lists at $100,915 a year on pay-as-you-go before the builders' Pro seats, so it only pays off for large audiences. The table below has 16 plans from 9 tools, each with its source and the date we checked it. The same rows are in a[CSV](https://www.getdot.ai/research/bi-pricing-index/bi-pricing-2026-11.csv) .


Annual list cost for 100 people. Plans that do not cover 100 people are left out.


## Business intelligence software pricing, plan by plan


Every cost is a yearly list price for the whole team. Where a vendor prices by role, the team is 10% people who build data sources and reports, 20% who explore and edit, and 70% who only view. "n/a" means the plan is not sold at that team size.
